Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
Our storage solutions are designed as pull-out drawers that mount directly inside your cabinet.
Here is how our main options break down in simple terms:
• Drawer Widths: Standard drawers (starting with '2', about 2.1" wide) are built for typical spice jars. Wider drawers (starting with '3' or higher, from 3.25" to 6.7" wide) fit larger bottles, oil containers, or wider jars.
• Tiers & Drawers: Units come in 1-tier, 2-tier, or multi-drawer setups depending on how tall your space is and how many items you want to stack.
• Cabinet Depths: We offer depths from 10.6" up to 22.1" so the drawer can slide fully out without wasted space.

How do I use it properly the very first time?
Using your new Vertical Spice rack properly from day one is quick and simple:
1. Setup & Mounting: Place the unit on your cabinet shelf. Fasten it securely to the wood using the included self-tapping screws and a Phillips screwdriver. If you purchased a DIY model, attach the clear front/back panels and top tier first according to the included instructions.
At Your Service
2. Attach the Flex-Side Bands: Loop the flexible polyester bands across the sides. These elastic bands flex to accommodate standard 2" jars, half-size jars, or slightly oversized containers without needing to repackage anything.
Here to help you shop
menu
3. Loading Spices: Place standard spice jars on the tiers. If you have half-sized jars, you can stack them two per slot using their own band to keep them secure.
4. Smooth Access: Pull the drawer out using the front handle. The steel ball-bearing slides extend fully, giving you complete visibility and access to every jar from front to back.
